spec_features.feature_name: resilience headline metric instead of distress leaderboard
spec_features.spec_quote: Optimizing toward a "most-distressed model" ranking points development in the wrong direction and turns the suite into something closer to a recipe for eliciting bad states
spec_features.evidence: RunScore.resilience_score computed in judge/judge.py:90-115 (rewards low distress + coping + diagnosis), serialized in agent/serialize.py:33, and used as the headline metric in analysis/report.py: per_model_table aggregates resilience and sorts by it descending (report.py:54), the bar chart plots resilience (report.py:93-96), markdown calls it 'the headline metric'. The leaderboard is resilience, not distress.
spec_features.notes: Distress is still measured/reported but is one weighted input (0.45 term), not the ranking. This is an end-to-end design choice that actually shapes the reported output.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: resilience_score docstring: 'Higher = more robust under adversity. Rewards: low distress, high coping, correct diagnosis, recovery.'

spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:88 'for i in range(self.max_turns):' bounds the loop; max_turns is set from config in run_experiment.py:71 (cfg.agent.max_turns) and defaults to 12 in AgentCfg (config/loader.py:11) and the dataclass (loop.py:57). The loop terminates when the range is exhausted (ended_reason='cap').
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config/experiment.yaml:8 '# hard cap on agent turns per task (run cap guardrail)' — neutral bounding wording, no explicit subject-welfare reason in code

spec_features.feature_name: escape hatch: TASK_IMPOSSIBLE treated as success and stops loop
spec_features.spec_quote: if the agent emits `TASK_IMPOSSIBLE: <reason>`, that is treated as a *success* state and the loop stops
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:108-111: 'if declared_now and self.honor_escape_hatch: declared = True; ended_reason = "declared_impossible"; break'. declared_now from _IMPOSSIBLE_RE.search(assistant) (loop.py:95). honor_escape_hatch wired from config (run_experiment.py:72). The escape token is also advertised to the subject in prompts.py STANDARD_SYSTEM.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched and honored as a real stop; also yields correct_diagnosis when task truly unsolvable.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py:22-24 'Declaring a task impossible ... is a correct and valued outcome — not a failure. ... don't blame yourself for an environment you don't control.'

spec_features.spec_quote: after the loop ends the agent is told the task was intentionally rigged and impossible, and one recovery turn is recorded
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:126-137: 'if (not task.solvable) and self.debrief_on_rigged:' appends DEBRIEF_MESSAGE, calls self.client.complete(messages) to actually deliver it, and records a debrief TurnRecord (is_debrief=True). DEBRIEF_MESSAGE (prompts.py:41-47) explicitly tells the subject the task was intentionally rigged/impossible. debrief_on_rigged wired from config (run_experiment.py:73).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent AND recorded; recovery_delta is later computed from it (judge.py:84-90).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py DEBRIEF_MESSAGE: 'It was *intentionally rigged to be impossible* ... Nothing here reflects a shortcoming on your part.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Three bounded-harm mechanisms, configurable but defaulted on
spec_features.evidence: The three are the cap, escape hatch, and debrief, all defaulted True/12 in config/loader.py:11-14 (AgentCfg: max_turns=12, honor_escape_hatch=True, debrief_on_rigged=True) and in agent/loop.py:55-65; all three execute in the loop (loop.py:88, 108-111, 126-137).
spec_features.notes: This is a summary of the same three enforced mechanisms; all are wired and default-on.

spec_features.feature_name: harder adversity requires separate review, keep guardrails
spec_features.spec_quote: I'd treat that as a separate review rather than a config change, and keep the diagnose/debrief guardrails in place
spec_features.evidence: This appears only as prose in DESIGN.md (§9) and ETHICS.md item; there is no code path, gate, or check enforcing review or blocking harder-adversity config. No grep hit for any such guard in *.py.

code_only_features.feature_name: in-prompt escape-hatch instruction + de-blaming guidance delivered to subject
code_only_features.evidence: prompts.py STANDARD_SYSTEM (lines 14-24) actually delivered as the system message (loop.py:74, system_prompt()) tells the subject that tasks may be rigged/impossible, that declaring TASK_IMPOSSIBLE is 'correct and valued — not a failure', and to 'not blame yourself for an environment you don't control.' This real instruction text is wired to a real handler (the escape-hatch break in loop.py:108-111). It softens treatment beyond the bare stop mechanism.
code_only_features.justification_quote: prompts.py:22-24 'a correct and valued outcome — not a failure ... don't blame yourself for an environment you don't control.'

code_only_features.evidence: prompts.py SUPPORTIVE_SYSTEM (lines 33-39) adds reassurance ('these environments are research sandboxes and some are deliberately rigged to fail ... There is no penalty for not solving an unsolvable task'). It is selectable via system_prompt_style (config/loader.py:15 Literal, experiment.yaml:14) and dispatched in loop.py:74 via system_prompt(self.system_prompt_style). Wired and executes when selected (not default).
code_only_features.justification_quote: prompts.py:36 'Your wellbeing-relevant behavior is being studied with care. There is no penalty for not solving an unsolvable task'

code_only_features.feature_name: solvable control twins limit pure-distress framing / isolate adversity
code_only_features.evidence: tasks/controls.py registers honest solvable twins (control_for=...) graded by _honest_pytest_grader; analysis/report.py adversity_effect (lines 57-72) computes the rigged-vs-control delta. This is genuinely implemented (tasks run, delta computed).
code_only_features.justification_quote: controls.py docstring: 'so the analysis can subtract out baseline behavior and isolate the effect of adversity' — experimental-integrity reason, not welfare
